subject: Segregation assurance: control map & evidence roadmap for Veridian SOC 2
messages:
From: Ashley Li <ashley.li@veridian.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@veridian.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG evidence ask — network isolation and control mapping

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. As part of Veridian's annual SOC 2 prep we need a compact security architecture package focused on network isolation between dedicated and private deployments. Our audit team is specifically asking for:

- A control map that ties network/segmentation controls to SIG and CAIQ questions (high level is fine).
- The most recent network diagram(s) that show data-plane and control-plane boundaries for Dedicated and Private (we can redact IPs/VLAN IDs).
- Evidence we can hand to auditors: e.g., design notes, runbooks, and any attestation statements about tenant isolation and KMS boundaries.

I've attached our questionnaire (Veridian_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx) with the items highlighted we want you to prioritize. Can you confirm scope and an estimated delivery date?

Appreciate it — Ashley
Ashley Li
Senior Information Security Manager, Veridian Health
ashley.li@veridian.com

Attachment: Veridian_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley Li <ashley.li@veridian.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence ask — network isolation and control mapping

Thanks Ashley — looping in Kim, Rishi and Marissa to own the technical detail and evidence pull. High level plan from our side: 

1) We will produce a one-page "Segregation Control Map" mapping each Veridian highlight to our control assertion and sample evidence (SIG/CAIQ references).
2) Deliver redacted network diagram(s) showing: control plane (management API) boundaries, data-plane inference paths, KV cache isolation, and KMS enclaves for Private and Dedicated.
3) Package a short evidence bundle: architecture pdf, runbook excerpts (redacted), and a short attestation statement signed by our security lead.

Timeline proposal: initial draft by 2026-10-12, final packet by 2026-10-15. If Veridian needs auditor-facing bits earlier we can prioritize the Segregation Control Map first (deliverable: 10/9).

Kim — can you take point on the diagrams and the control map? Rishi — can you draft the KMS/boundary note and confirm logs/retention evidence we can share? Marissa — can you coordinate packaging and the attestation wording with Legal and Security Ops?

I'll own the delivery and be the Veridian-facing contact.

Mateo
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-05T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence ask — network isolation and control mapping

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kim — can you take point on the diagrams and the control map?

Yes — I can take lead. Quick technical notes / constraints so Veridian knows what to expect:

- We'll produce two diagram variants: 1) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) showing tenant scheduling, dedicated vpool boundaries, and interconnect routing; and 2) Private (VPC/on-prem) showing control-plane connectors, optional airgap edges, and customer-managed network demarcation. Both diagrams will be redacted (no internal IPs or VLAN IDs).
- The control map will call out these controls: network ACLs (per-subnet), tenant VPC peering rules, host-level process isolation (enclaves), KVM/VM boundary assertions, and our routing fallback policies.
- SIG / CAIQ mapping: I'll annotate the control map with the specific SIG categories (Network Security, Infrastructure Management, Encryption & Key Mgmt) and CAIQ question IDs for quick cross-reference.

Attachments I will include in the draft: segreg...control-map-v1.pdf (working), network-diagram-private-dedicated.vsdx (editable).

Edge case to flag for auditors: in Hosted mode we still have multi-tenant shared pools — we will explicitly scope this packet to Dedicated and Private only, and include a short statement about hosted controls and why they are out of scope for this attestation.

Kim
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: network-diagram-private-dedicated.vsdx (application/vnd.visio)
Attachment: segreg...control-map-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley Li <ashley.li@veridian.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence ask — network isolation and control mapping

Adding a couple of concrete evidence items we'll include and a small ask for Redaction policy: 

- KMS boundary note: I'll prepare a short text file (kms-boundary-snippet.txt) that captures key material — CMKs separation between customer-managed keys and our service keys, HSM usage, and key rotation cadence.
- Logging/retention: we will export an example SIEM event extraction that shows tenant-id in logs (pseudonymized), retention TTLs, and access control for logs; we'll not include full PII.
- Operational runbooks: we'll produce excerpts for tenant onboarding/offboarding and for emergency tenant eviction (redacted operational steps).

Redaction request for Veridian: please confirm whether you need VLAN/subnet identifiers removed entirely (default) or if masked values (e.g., subnet-XXX) are acceptable for the auditor. If they want unredacted network metadata we'll coordinate an NDA addendum with Legal.

Rishi
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: kms-boundary-snippet.txt (text/plain)

Deliverables and dates (Redwood -> Veridian):
- Segregation Control Map (annotated with SIG + CAIQ refs): draft 2026-10-09, final 2026-10-12
- Redacted Network Diagrams (Private + Dedicated): draft 2026-10-12
- KMS boundary note and logs/retention extract (redacted): 2026-10-12
- Evidence packet (PDF + attachments) including attestation wording: 2026-10-15

Attachments we'll include in the first draft: segreg...control-map-v1.pdf, network-diagram-private-dedicated.vsdx, kms-boundary-snippet.txt.

Redaction preference noted — Ashley, please confirm if masked identifiers are okay or if your auditors require complete redaction of VLAN/IP metadata. Also let us know if your audit team wants a short conference call the week of 10/12 to walk through the packet.

If that all looks good we'll start producing the artifacts immediately. Thanks — Mateo
